sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). The league leaders are coming off a recent loss but remain unbeaten over their last five in terms of overall record, having won seven of their ten matches so far. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are in poor form, making this a favorable encounter for Sandbach to bounce back.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, a key fixture in the title race as they sit just 2 points behind Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall (sixth, 18 points) in a clash between two of the division's stronger sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community before facing Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. In-form Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir, while Barnton host Shawbury United in a mid-table encounter. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a battle between two of the league's weakest-performing teams. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; Widnes remain rooted to the bottom with just 2 points. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a fixture involving two sides outside the top ten.
